title: Seeing people who were not there
summary: She tells of warning her brother-in-law about a man in the street and grabbing the wheel on tour for an old couple who were not there.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: No, you can't control it... You see these things when you're not even expecting them. I may be walking down the street with somebody - there was a little incident when my brother-in-law was bringing me home from

a party and he carried me on his shoulder, because I had gone to sleep. That's what the men did in the family. I I was a little tired they'd just put me on their shoulder and take me home. I woke up and I said, "Don't walk into that man." He started running with me because it's a frightening thing, you know. I could see a man on the street but he couldn't see him. Once with Andy Kirk's band I grabbed the wheel because I saw an old couple on the road, passing, and the old man was crippled and passed in front of the car and /I/ grabbed the wheel... and they weren't there. I was the only person that saw it.
What would have happened, do you suppose, if you hadn't grabbed the wheel and gone right straight through what you say wasn't really there. Would there have been something there?

It could be an accident but I'm in control of that now. I've seen things while I was driving but I just kept straight through it. That happened to me not too long ago, I guess about 20 years ago, or 15. I saw a little kid run in front of the car. He was not there. Seemed like all of a sudden I thought, gosh, it's after one o'clock. There's no kid out here this size... Perhaps some little kid had got killed there.
